tips.text: Crack relics in quick public Capture, Exterminate or Rescue fissures; Void Cascade is the favorite if you know how to run it.
Solo Rescue or Capture on a fast frame like Titania, Volt or Uriel; in a public squad pick Defense or Survival so no one holds up extraction.
Keep spare uncommon and rare Prime parts between visits so the Ducats are ready when the Vandal appears.
Do not count on Baro's Void Surplus for Ducats; it has a 2% chance of 1,000.
Check the r/Warframe Baro inventory post the day he lands; the Kiosk countdown does not show his stock.
Do not assume the Tenet Quanta covers this one; each has its own Mastery.
Nobody complains about the weapon itself; the only friction is catching a Baro visit that stocks it.
